inputs.name: pitch
inputs.doc: MIDI pitch per token; MARKER_PITCH for the two segment markers

inputs.name: segment
inputs.doc: 0 for the score half (marker included), 1 for the perf half

inputs.name: position
inputs.doc: index within the segment; restarts at 0 at the perf marker

outputs.name: match_s
outputs.doc: null (deletion) logit per token — matchability_s applied to the PRE-projection encoder output

outputs.name: match_p
outputs.doc: null (insertion) logit per token — matchability_p applied to the PRE-projection encoder output

outputs.name: scale
outputs.doc: the learned logit scale, identical to head.scale below

featurize.token_layout: [MARKER] s_1 .. s_n [MARKER] p_1 .. p_m   (T = 2 + n + m)
featurize.position: arange(1 + n) for the score half, then arange(1 + m) for the perf half

cont_channels.name: delta
cont_channels.note: the first note of each half has delta 0 (numpy diff prepends its own onset)

cont_channels.name: segment_flag
cont_channels.expr: 0.0 for score notes, 1.0 for perf notes

head.sim: sim[i][j] = dot(s[1 + i], p[2 + n + j]) * scale        # (n, m)
head.null_row: null_row[j] = match_p[2 + n + j]                   # (m,) insertion logit
head.matchability_applies_to: the encoder output BEFORE out_s/out_p — the graph already does this, so the host must NOT re-derive the null logits from s/p

host.accumulate: per window: sim += logits_s2p[:n, :m] + logits_p2s[:m, :n].T (so every covered cell holds 2x the raw sim), then divide by the window count; the null logits are averaged the same way
host.decode_constants: not duplicated here on purpose — they belong to the decode (mlign.infer.decode), not to the model contract
